
## Summary

**Adopt a dashboard typography token system** (residual after DUX5)

Titles, values, units, body text, tables and axes have inconsistent scale and auto-shrink.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-01`
- DUX code: `DUX6-10`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: all

## Concrete change

Implement the typography baseline in this report and forbid shrink below minimums.

## Expected effect

Consistent hierarchy and readable text across viewports.

## Acceptance criteria

- Automated screenshot checks confirm token floors; no panel title/body/table text below minimum at 1366×768.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana theme and library-panel conventions.

## Risk

Grafana native controls may not expose every token; document exceptions.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7123 DUX5-10 closed — residual: enforce typography floors in render evidence

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX6 epic (#7139)
